Manuscripts Under Review 11

7 first-author and 4 co-author manuscripts under peer review. Author lists are withheld under double-blind review.

First author

  • Unified Evaluation Framework for RAG Chunking

    EMNLP 2026 — Joint measurement of retrieval relevance, evidence breadth, faithfulness, latency, memory, and cost for fair chunker comparison.

  • Delivered-Pack Sensitivity Diagnostics for Document-Agent Memory Commits

    EMNLP 2026 — Demonstrates that final-answer correctness alone is not evidence of grounding; proposes diagnostics on what an agent commits to memory.

  • Timestamp-Grounded Evidence Consumption Auditing for Long-Video QA/RAG

    EMNLP 2026 — Shifts video QA/RAG evaluation beyond final-answer accuracy by auditing which timestamped segments were actually consumed.

  • Evidence Auditing and Support-Sensitive Evaluation for Multimodal QA

    TACL — A matched-reader audit framework separates real evidence use from evaluation illusions in multimodal QA.

  • Error Propagation Diagnostics for PDF-to-RAG Pipelines Across Representation Families

    IEEE TPAMI — A matched-intervention diagnostic framework analyzing how upstream parsing uncertainty propagates across PDF-to-RAG representation families.

  • Evidence-State Control for Repairing, Recalibrating, and Materializing Retrieved Candidates

    ML Conference — Controllable repair, recalibration, and materialization of retrieved candidates before reader-context packing.

  • Answer-Side Attribution Analysis of OCR, Evidence Placement, Answer Policy, and Reader Family

    ML Conference — Attribution analysis of how OCR quality, evidence placement, answer policy, and reader family interact to affect answer-quality gains.
